title: Point images and topology of algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $F$ be a presheaf of sets on schemes over $S$, with the test schemes and universes used for algebraic spaces [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Let $|F|$ be its set of field-valued point classes, with field-valued representatives and, for a scheme $T$ and $a:h_T\to F$, the map $|a|:|T|\to|F|$ sending $t\in T$ to the class of its residue-field representative, as in [def-a1-algebraic-space-point-classes]. For $f:E\to F$, its point image is the subset of $|F|$ consisting of the classes of $f(x)$ for field-valued representatives $x$ of $E$. Give $|F|$ the final topology for all representable etale maps $a:h_T\to F$ with $T$ a scheme [def-trf-algebraic-space]: a subset is open exactly when its inverse image under every such $|a|$ is open in $T$. For an algebraic space this is its usual atlas topology.
